query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456') UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01' AND policy_id IN ('fe7c786ab321f41c654ef6c1af7b3250a613c24e4213e0425a7ae456')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
